scientific_integrity: Elementary universal proof with an exact-arithmetic reproducibility script; finite checks are evidence rather than proof. Literature priority independently unverified.
scientific_limitations: Exact classification only for positive multiples of b^t-1; shortest lengths established for the first intermediate sums only. Related 2023 work formulates a broader arc-set question and a 2016 article records the earlier binary lower bound. Earlier equivalent folklore is possible.
title: Complete digit-sum spectrum and two-block rigidity for \(b^t-1\)
